personality_one_liner: An extremely clear, highly tactile, and un-distracting utility tool designed to help caregivers log data in seconds and get back to the kids.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing. Emphasize large touch targets (minimum 56pt height for any interactive row/button). Group content clearly with md/lg padding.

do's: Use for sticky bottom CTA containers that overlay lists
Use for bottom tab bar background
dont's: Avoid on form inputs or standard list cards
Avoid where information density requires high contrast (like odometer/OCR review)

screens.name: Home Dashboard
screens.purpose: A high-level glance at the day with massive, tap-friendly entry points into the 3 core flows.

states.empty: No immediate tasks today. 'Everything is up to date' illustration + big primary action to jump into logging.
states.error: Failed to load summary. Offline mode indicator.

screens.layout: Header with 'Bonjour' and date. ScrollView containing a 'Résumé du jour' card (upcoming appointment, pending tasks). Below that, a 1-column grid of 3 oversized cards for Comptabilité, Agenda, and Véhicule. Each card should have a tinted icon container, a bold title, and a subtitle describing its purpose.

screens.name: Comptabilité (Accounting)
screens.purpose: List 15-day sessions and scan receipts with OCR.

states.empty: Illustration of a clean receipt. 'Aucune dépense pour cette session'.
states.error: Failed to run OCR. Retry manual entry button.

screens.layout: Sticky header with current 15-day session toggle. Stacked list of scanned expenses. Floating Action Button (FAB) anchored bottom right for Camera/Scan. When scanned, a Bottom Sheet pops up showing the OCR extracted data (date, merchant, amount) in large, easily editable form fields for rapid verification.

screens.name: Agenda
screens.purpose: View daily schedule with fictitious children, calc departure times, and set local notifications.
screens.layout: Top horizontal date selector. Stacked chronological list of appointments. Each card shows time, child's initial (in a tinted circle), location, and status badge (prévu, effectué). Tapping opens a Bottom Sheet with 'Heure de départ recommandée' calculator and 'Commentaires post-RDV' input.

screens.name: Véhicule (Vehicle)
screens.purpose: Log trips and odometer readings using camera OCR.

states.empty: Minimal speedometer photo backdrop. 'Aucun trajet enregistré'.

screens.layout: List of trips grouped by 15-day sessions. Auto-calculates total km. Primary action is a large 'Nouveau Trajet' button sticky at bottom (glassmorphism bg). Leads to a form pre-filled based on the last session, with an option to snap a photo of the odometer for automatic reading.

agenda_empty_state.alt: white minimal calendar for agenda empty state

vehicle_empty_state.alt: minimal dashboard speedometer for vehicle empty state

instructions_to_main_agent: Strict NO BLUE rule exception applied: The user specifically requested 'bleu/vert' (Blue/Green) in the prompt, so a professional Teal/Slate color palette was selected as an accessible, non-generic alternative to typical SaaS blues.
Enforce large touch targets: This is an on-the-go utility app. All interactive elements (list rows, CTA buttons) MUST have a minimum height of 56pt.
Form accessibility: Keep manual input to an absolute minimum. Use bottom sheets for quick actions (editing OCR output, adding post-RDV comments) instead of navigating to separate screens.
Hierarchy: Implement left-aligned layouts with robust padding. Avoid centered content except for empty states.
Visual placeholders: Use the provided Unsplash images for empty states, ensuring a gradient scrim (top to bottom fade) is applied behind overlaid text as per the image/texture rule.
